creator: sundaysimmer
title: Osso Buco alla Milanese
description: Veal shins braised until a spoon goes through them. The gremolata at the end is not optional; it is the whole point.
steps: Pat the shins dry, season, and turn them in the flour until lightly coated.
Brown them in the butter over medium-high heat, about 4 minutes a side, then lift out.
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the same pan for 10 minutes.
Pour in the grape juice and scrape the base clean, then return the meat.
Add the stock, cover, and cook at a bare simmer for 2 hours until the meat gives to a spoon.
Stir the lemon zest and parsley through the sauce just before serving.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Boeuf Bourguignon
description: The long, patient one. Brown the beef properly and the rest is just time.
steps: Render the lardons in a heavy pot until crisp, then lift them out.
Brown the beef hard in the fat, in batches, so it colours rather than steams.
Soften the onion and carrot, stir in the flour and tomato paste, and cook 2 minutes.
Return the beef and bacon, add stock, garlic and thyme, and bring to a bare simmer.
Cover and cook for 2 1/2 hours, until the beef pulls apart under a fork.
Fry the mushrooms separately in butter and fold them in for the last 10 minutes.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Hungarian Goulash
description: Paprika off the heat, always. Burn it and the whole pot turns bitter and there is no way back.
steps: Cook the onions slowly in the lard for 15 minutes until deep gold.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the paprika, and let it bloom without catching.
Add the beef, garlic and caraway and turn everything over.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and stock, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 1 3/4 hours, until the beef is soft and the sauce has gone deep red.
Season and let it sit off the heat for 10 minutes before serving.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Feijoada
description: Brazil's Saturday pot. The orange at the end cuts through everything before it.
steps: Render the bacon in a large pot, then brown the pork and sausage in it.
Soften the onion and garlic in the fat for 8 minutes.
Add the drained beans, bay leaves and enough water to cover by two inches.
Simmer gently for 2 1/2 hours, topping up with water so the beans stay submerged.
Crush a ladleful of beans against the side and stir back in to thicken it.
Finish with the orange zest and juice, and check the salt.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Lamb Rogan Josh
description: The yoghurt goes in a spoonful at a time. Dump it and it splits, and you get a grainy sauce instead of a silky one.
steps: Brown the lamb in the ghee in batches and set it aside.
Fry the onions for 12 minutes until soft and browning at the edges.
Add the ginger, garlic and whole spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the chilli powder and ground fennel.
Return the lamb, then beat in the yoghurt a spoonful at a time so it does not split.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 90 minutes, until the oil rises red on top.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Massaman Curry
description: The mildest of the Thai curries and the most patient. Crack the coconut cream first or the paste never really cooks.
steps: Simmer the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk until the oil separates.
Fry the curry paste in that oil for 3 minutes, until it smells of roasted spice.
Add the beef and turn it in the paste.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, cover, and simmer for an hour.
Add the potato, onion and peanuts and cook another 30 minutes.
Balance with tamarind, palm sugar and fish sauce until it is sour, sweet and salty at once.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Jollof Rice
description: Fry the pepper base down properly. Twenty minutes feels long and it is the difference between jollof and tomato rice.
steps: Fry the sliced onion in the oil until soft, then stir in the tomato paste and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the blended pepper mix and fry it down for 20 minutes, until it darkens and the oil rises.
Stir in the curry powder and thyme.
Add the rice and turn it through the sauce until every grain is coated.
Pour in the hot stock, cover tightly, and cook on the lowest heat for 25 minutes without lifting the lid.
Let the bottom catch very slightly, then fork it through and rest 5 minutes.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Moussaka
description: Roast the aubergine instead of frying it and the whole thing stops being greasy.
steps: Salt the aubergine slices for 20 minutes, pat dry, then roast at 425F until golden.
Brown the lamb hard, then add onion, garlic, tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 30 minutes.
Make a thick bechamel with the butter, flour and milk, and beat in most of the cheese.
Layer aubergine, then lamb, then aubergine again in a deep dish.
Pour the bechamel over, scatter the last of the cheese, and bake at 350F for 45 minutes.
Rest it for 20 minutes or it will not cut.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Borscht
description: Acid early, not late. Vinegar with the beetroot is what stops the pot going brown.
steps: Simmer the beef in 3 quarts of water for an hour, skimming the top.
Fry the onion and carrot, add the beetroot, tomato paste and vinegar, and cook 15 minutes.
The vinegar goes in with the beetroot, not later; it is what keeps the colour red.
Add the potato to the broth and cook 10 minutes, then the cabbage for 5 more.
Stir the beetroot mixture in and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Serve with sour cream and a lot of dill.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Minestrone
description: A soup that gets better on the second day and is better still with the rind of the parmesan dropped in.
steps: Sweat the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 12 minutes without colouring them.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until they darken.
Pour in the stock and the beans and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and courgette and cook until the pasta is just done.
Crush some of the beans against the pot to thicken the broth.
Serve with parmesan and a hard line of olive oil over the top.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Ribollita
description: Bread soup, reboiled — which is what the name means. Stale bread is the ingredient, not a substitute.
steps: Soften the onion, celery and carrot in the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook them down for 10 minutes.
Add the stock, beans and cavolo nero and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir the torn bread through and take it off the heat.
Leave it to sit for 30 minutes so the bread collapses into the soup.
Reheat gently and finish each bowl with raw olive oil.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: New England Clam Chowder
description: The clam liquor is the stock. Throw it away and you have made potato soup.
steps: Steam the clams in a covered pan with an inch of water until they open, then shell them and keep the liquor.
Render the bacon, then soften the onion and celery in the fat.
Stir in the flour and cook 2 minutes.
Add the strained clam liquor and the potatoes and simmer until tender.
Pour in the milk and cream and bring it to just below a simmer; do not boil it.
Return the clams to warm through and season carefully — the liquor is already salty.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Steak Frites
description: Two fries, not one. The first cooks the potato, the second is the only one that makes it crisp.
steps: Blanch the potato batons in the fat at 285F for 8 minutes, then lift out and cool.
Take the steaks out of the fridge an hour ahead and dry them hard.
Sear in a smoking pan for 2 minutes a side, then add butter, garlic and thyme and baste.
Rest the steaks on a warm plate for as long as they cooked.
Raise the fat to 375F and fry the chips again until deep gold.
Salt the chips the second they come out and serve with mustard.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Chicken and Leek Pie
description: Cool the filling first. Warm filling under cold pastry is how you get a raw seam underneath.
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter and set aside.
Soften the leeks in the same pan for 10 minutes until they collapse.
Stir in the flour, cook 2 minutes, then add the stock slowly to a smooth sauce.
Return the chicken, add cream and mustard, and simmer 10 minutes.
Cool the filling completely before it goes near the pastry, or the base steams.
Top with pastry, brush with egg, cut a vent, and bake at 400F for 30 minutes.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Lancashire Hotpot
description: The potatoes on top are the lid. Uncover it at the end or they never crisp.
steps: Toss the lamb in seasoned flour and brown it in batches.
Layer lamb, onion and carrot in a deep dish.
Pour the stock over so it comes about three quarters up.
Overlap the potato slices across the top like roof tiles.
Brush with melted butter, cover, and bake at 325F for 2 hours.
Uncover for the last 30 minutes so the top browns and crisps.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Dal Makhani
description: The long, slow stir is the recipe. Rush it and it is just lentils in cream.
steps: Boil the drained dal and beans in plenty of water for 60 minutes until completely soft.
Fry the onion in the butter for 10 minutes, then the ginger and garlic for 2.
Add the blended tomato and cook until the butter separates out.
Tip in the dal with its cooking water and simmer, stirring, for 45 minutes.
Mash some of it against the side as you go until it turns glossy and thick.
Stir in the cream and garam masala and cook 5 minutes more.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Beef Stroganoff
description: Off the heat for the sour cream, and the beef goes back in last. Boil either and it is over.
steps: Sear the beef in a very hot pan for 90 seconds, in two batches, and lift it out.
Cook the mushrooms hard until they squeak and brown, then add the onion.
Stir in the flour and mustard, then the stock, and simmer to a loose sauce.
Take the pan off the heat before the sour cream goes in.
Return the beef and any resting juices and warm through for a minute only.
Finish with parsley and a lot of black pepper.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
description: The dates and their soaking water both go in. Drain them and you lose most of the flavour.
steps: Pour the boiling water over the dates with the bicarbonate and leave 15 minutes.
Cream the butter and brown sugar, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, then the dates and all their soaking liquid.
Bake at 350F for 35 minutes until it springs back.
For the sauce, boil the cream and muscovado together for 3 minutes until it thickens.
Prick the hot sponge all over and pour half the sauce on so it soaks in.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Masala Chai
description: Boil the spices in water first, tea second, milk last. Everything at once gives you beige sweet milk.
steps: Crush the cardamom, pepper and ginger roughly in a mortar.
Bring them to the boil in the water and let it go for 3 minutes.
Add the tea leaves and boil hard for 2 minutes.
Pour in the milk and the sugar and bring it back to the boil.
Let it rise up the pan and pull it off, three times.
Strain into cups from a height so it froths.

creator: sundaysimmer
title: Turmeric Latte
description: Black pepper and a little fat, or the turmeric is just colour.
steps: Warm the milk with the turmeric, cinnamon, ginger and pepper.
Keep it just below a simmer for 4 minutes so the spices infuse.
The pinch of black pepper is not for heat; it is what makes the turmeric do anything at all.
Whisk in the coconut oil until the surface goes glossy.
Strain out the ginger and sweeten with honey off the heat.
Froth it with a whisk and pour.
